_about: M0 STT test set. 'read' prompts have a reference transcript; 'free' prompts are spoken freely and get their reference by hand-correcting the best transcript afterwards.

prompts.text: Let's start a new plan for the voice bridge on spiff, and keep the details in the vault.
Switch to the herdr session that's working on the meeting recorder.
Can the k3s pod reach the herdr socket the same way Collie does?
Run the text to speech on khelt's 4090, and fall back to Kokoro on spiff if it's busy.
What did the Nebula control plane session decide about the lighthouse certificate rotation?
Put it behind Traefik on the app dot hyde dot ca wildcard, tailnet only, no Funnel.
Tell me more about the Syxsense health hub deploy on tlg1.
Is Pomerium still rejecting the Argo hub login, or did the Entra group fix land?
Merge the green Renovate pull requests and let fleet redeploy them.
Hmm, actually, scratch that. Let's keep Parakeet for now and test Nemotron streaming later.
Write the comparison to a detail file and just give me the headline.
Read me the risks section of the plan.
The pipeline uses Pipecat with Smart Turn, and the transcript comes from the session's JSONL.
Should the default model be Opus or Sonnet for the planning sessions?
Check whether Frigate and Ollama are still sharing the GTX 1080 without trouble.
Send me a Pushover note when the CachyOS update finishes, about twenty minutes from now.
I finished book seven of All the Skills, and I'd rate it four and a half out of five.
Add a step: verify with kubectl rollout status, then hit the healthz endpoint.
Open the Obsidian note on the WSL setup and check the system-config tweak for the SSH agent.
Okay. So. The thing I really want is, um, quick back and forth, not ten pages read at me.
Use Drama 3 with the int4 experts, and measure time to first audio over the LAN.
Does the KOReader plugin still sync with Calibre-Web over OPDS?
List my sessions, then pin the one about the Mac apps on Windows.
Interrupt it. That's going the wrong way; go back to the version from yesterday.
How much would ElevenLabs cost at a hundred replies a day, roughly, per month?
Free: describe a small new project idea you've been thinking about, in your own words, pauses and all.
Free: ask the infra session a question about something on spiff or the cluster.
Free: give feedback on a plan, as if you'd just heard a two-sentence summary.
Free: a work question about Syxsense, Argo, or Nebula, with the real names.
Free: change your mind halfway through a sentence, the way you naturally would.
